caption: The drawing features a single cup depicted in the center, rendered in pencil and shades of grey. The cup has a slightly outward-flaring rim and a smooth, continuous surface. Decorative script initials “H.C.A.” are inscribed on the upper portion of the cup’s body. The cup is positioned within a large rectangular border that is lightly outlined on the paper. In the lower left corner, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing of the same cup, also contained within a rectangle. The background of the image is a plain, light beige color with some darker shading, especially at the corners and edges. The composition is minimal and focused on the central cup drawing and its smaller counterpart.
title: Silver Mug
